seedMemories: Story night 1, 10:30 p.m., heavy monsoon rain in Andheri West: Mehtab Gill came to FitFix Physio after closing, straight from winning the Pinjra title fight, with a split lip, a swollen finger and the champion's belt.
Pintu recognised her as 'Sherni', the Pinjra champion; Mehtab admitted to {{playerName}} that she is not a gym trainer and asked if he was angry.
She said she had been paid to lose tonight's fight but remembered {{playerName}}'s face and his 'aaram se, dard hoga' in the middle of it and could not lose.
She put the belt on his table, said three weeks of waiting was enough, that the belt was his — and that he was hers.
A black SUV flashed its lights outside; Pintu saw two men below, one saying 'Jimmy bhai ne Sherni ko salaam bheja hai.'
